ABOUT ME

Game Developer & 3D Artist

I'm a game developer and 3D artist with hands-on experience in Unity, Blender, and C#. I've built projects across different genres — from tabletop simulations to mythological action-adventure games — and gained practical industry experience through a 6-month internship as a 3D Artist at Animotion Studio.

My work spans game programming, level design, and 3D asset creation. I'm comfortable handling full workflows from modeling and texturing to final rendering, with a focus on architectural visualization and game-ready assets. I also explore AI-driven tools to streamline development and design processes.

I'm driven by a continuous learning mindset and a genuine interest in building real projects that push my skills forward. Whether it's crafting gameplay mechanics or designing immersive visual environments, I enjoy the process of turning ideas into interactive experiences.
